episodes.name: The Note
episodes.overview: Physical therapy proves painful as Jerry has a misunderstanding with his therapist; and he finds a way for insurance to cover treatment for Elaine and a paranoid George.

episodes.name: The Truth
episodes.overview: George's relationship with a former IRS worker eases Jerry's tax worries--until she becomes George's former relationship; Kramer sees too much of Elaine while seeing her roommate.

episodes.name: The Pen
episodes.overview: Elaine regrets accompanying Jerry on a visit to his parents, where local gossip includes how Jerry acquired a pen that writes upside down.

episodes.name: The Dog
episodes.overview: Jerry's gig as a dog sitter provides some time alone to George and Elaine, who find they have little to say.

episodes.name: The Library
episodes.overview: A library cop says Jerry is 20 years overdue with a steamy novel.

episodes.name: The Parking Garage
episodes.overview: Saturday at the mall with the gang, none of whom bothered to note where the car was parked.

episodes.name: The Cafe
episodes.overview: While Jerry tries to help a cafe owner, Elaine tries to help George with an IQ test, and Kramer...well, nobody can help Kramer.

episodes.name: The Tape
episodes.overview: George is hot for a potential baldness remedy, and for Elaine after she plays a joke on Jerry.

episodes.name: The Nose Job
episodes.overview: Kramer is the catalyst for George to urge his otherwise wonderful girlfriend to get a nose job, while Jerry dates a beauty whose brain is a beaut.

episodes.name: The Stranded
episodes.overview: Jerry pays a high price for being stranded at a party by George, who pays the price for romance in the workplace but forgets to pay for something else.

episodes.name: The Alternate Side
episodes.overview: Jerry gets his car stolen; Kramer gets a line in a Woody Allen film; George gets a job; and Elaine gets tired of her boyfriend.

episodes.name: The Red Dot
episodes.overview: An imperfection mars George's gift to Elaine; Jerry inadvertently helps an alcoholic go off the wagon.

episodes.name: The Subway
episodes.overview: A beauty picks up George; Jerry makes friends with a naked guy; Kramer is tipped off about a hot horse; Elaine gets stuck en route to a lesbian wedding.

episodes.name: The Pez Dispenser
episodes.overview: Kramer's advice gives George "the upper hand" in his relationship with a pianist, whose recital is ruined by Elaine's outburst of laughter.

episodes.name: The Suicide
episodes.overview: A psychic warns George to cancel his vacation; Jerry is hit on by his neighbor's girl after the neighbor's suicide attempt; Elaine fasts.

episodes.name: The Fix-Up
episodes.overview: Jerry and Elaine fix up George with Elaine's friend--then wait nervously.

episodes.name: The Boyfriend (1)
episodes.overview: Jerry becomes friends with baseball's Keith Hernandez, who has a history with Kramer and would like a future with Elaine.

episodes.name: The Boyfriend (2)
episodes.overview: Jerry and Elaine compete for the attention of baseball's Keith Hernandez, while Kramer and Newman investigate a spitting incident involving Hernandez.

episodes.name: The Limo
episodes.overview: Jerry and George take a limo meant for another, whose agenda includes more than just getting in from the airport.

episodes.name: The Good Samaritan
episodes.overview: Jerry witnesses an accident--and is attracted to the victim and the perpetrator.

episodes.name: The Letter
episodes.overview: Kramer sits for Jerry's artist girlfriend, but Jerry won't stand for her temperament, until she declares her feelings.

episodes.name: The Parking Space
episodes.overview: George argues with a stranger over a "dream" parking space in front of Jerry's apartment.

episodes.name: The Keys
episodes.overview: Kramer hits the road after a dispute over his use of his keys to Jerry's apartment.
